summary: The main island as a scenario pack; the validator, the bundle output per scenario, and the scaffold CLI

coordination.notes: Contract: docs/SCENARIO_PACKS.md. The main scenario references the existing rule, production, diplomacy, buildings, personas and navigation files by path; nothing is copied. content/island/faction_roster.json is now redundant - each faction's entry is its own content/scenarios/pirate_island/factions/<name>.tuning.json - but the file is deliberately left in place this round because godot-rust/src/world.rs still include_str!s it from install_preview_factions; the scenario-runtime-loading lane deletes both together. Pack resolution (finding packs, resolving declared paths, embedding) has one owner, tools/src/scenario-pack.mjs, used by both the validator's scenario block and the extended bundle builder, rather than the same loader written twice. start.combatProfile is copied verbatim from prototype_island() in godot-rust/src/world.rs (health 30, damage 4, range 4, cooldown_ticks 5); the five seeds and production paths are copied verbatim from install_preview_factions() in the same file; JSON carries no comments, so this claim is the provenance record. 'Seed inside the navigation size' is read as navigation.size divided by navigation.cellSize, i.e. the 48-by-32 cell grid, since seeds are cell coordinates and size is pixels.
